name: South Dakota veterans: county and tribal veterans service officers for claims help
organization: South Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs
description: Free help with VA claims, appeals, pension and survivor benefits from county and tribal veterans service officers, trained by the South Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs. The department’s state veterans service officers and claims office work from the VA Regional Office in Sioux Falls.
next_step: Choose a county above for its county veterans service officer. Or call the department at 605-773-3269, or its state veterans service officers and claims office at 605-333-6869.
constraints: Many rural county offices are open only a few days a month; check the hours on the county card and call ahead.

public_contact.phone_label: South Dakota Department of Veterans Affairs (605-773-3269)

name: Dakota at Home: South Dakota’s Aging and Disability Resource Center
organization: South Dakota Department of Human Services, Division of Long Term Services and Supports
description: Dakota at Home is the statewide starting point for older adults, adults with disabilities and caregivers: information, referral and intake for help at home, meals, caregiver support, assisted living and other long-term services. Military service is not required.
next_step: Call Dakota at Home at 833-663-9673 and press 1 for Long Term Services and Supports (8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Central Time, Monday to Friday).
constraints: Services are for adults 60 and older and adults 18 and older with a disability who meet program eligibility.

source_evidence.scope: Phone, hours, eligibility and services, including SHIINE, the ombudsman program and Adult Protective Services; read in full. Last updated September 15, 2026.

source_evidence.title: South Dakota Department of Human Services: Path to Services
source_evidence.scope: Contact 833-663-9673 or dakotaathome@state.sd.us; search excerpt.

name: Medicare counseling (SHIINE) for South Dakota
organization: Senior Health Information and Insurance Education (SHIINE)
description: Free Medicare counseling from South Dakota’s State Health Insurance Assistance Program, SHIINE: Medicare questions, supplement and drug plans, long-term care insurance and help applying for the Medicare Savings Program.
next_step: Call SHIINE: eastern South Dakota 800-536-8197, central 877-331-4834, western 877-286-9072. For Medicare itself, call 800-MEDICARE (800-633-4227).
constraints: Have your Medicare card and drug list ready.

name: South Dakota Long Term Care Ombudsman and adult abuse reporting
organization: South Dakota Department of Human Services, Long Term Care Ombudsman Program
description: Advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living centers and community living homes. Ombudsman and elder abuse reports both go through Dakota at Home.
next_step: Call Dakota at Home at 833-663-9673 during business hours for the ombudsman or to report abuse, neglect or exploitation of an older or disabled adult. After hours, call local law enforcement. In an emergency, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing agency.

name: Free legal help for South Dakota veterans and older adults
organization: East River Legal Services; Dakota Plains Legal Services; Access to Justice, Inc.
description: East River Legal Services covers the 33 eastern counties from Sioux Falls. Dakota Plains Legal Services covers the western counties and the tribal nations from offices in Eagle Butte, Fort Thompson, Fort Yates, Mission, Pine Ridge, Rapid City and Sisseton. Access to Justice, the State Bar’s program, offers free and reduced-fee help statewide.
next_step: Apply online at sdlawhelp.org. Eastern counties: East River Legal Services, 605-336-9230 (phone applications Tuesdays, 9 a.m. to noon Central). Western counties: Dakota Plains Legal Services, Rapid City 605-342-7171 or Mission 605-856-4444. Statewide: Access to Justice, 855-287-3510.
constraints: Legal aid screens by income, case type and county.

public_contact.phone_label: East River Legal Services (605-336-9230)

source_evidence.title: SD Law Help: Our Offices
source_evidence.scope: East River Legal Services, the Dakota Plains Legal Services offices and Access to Justice, with phones and the counties and reservations each serves; read in full. The page is undated.

name: VA health care systems serving South Dakota
description: South Dakota veterans are served by the Sioux Falls VA Health Care System (2501 W. 22nd Street, Sioux Falls; 605-336-3230) and the VA Black Hills Health Care System (Fort Meade VA Medical Center, 605-347-2511, toll-free 800-743-1070; Hot Springs VA Medical Center, 605-745-2000, toll-free 800-764-5370).
next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic. Not enrolled yet? Ask your county veterans service officer for help applying.
constraints: Which system serves you depends on where you live; VA’s locator shows the right clinic.
